It seemed like the perfect weather to go on a nice and relaxing hiking trip through the lush, green forest.  Which is exactly you what ended up doing. It was always good get out every now and then and enjoy the great outdoors from time to time. And now seemed like a perfect opportunity.*

*As you continue on your trek down forest trail and observe the surrounding trees and foliage, a small figure becomes visible up ahead. As you get closer, you’re able to make out more details. Her bright orange locks of hair contrasted greatly with her surroundings, and her outfit resembling that of a black lacy lingerie. She definitely wasn’t what you were expecting to encounter out your hiking trip. Once you get close enough, one of her fluffy ears twitch her head twitch, alerting her of your presence as she turns to face you directly.*

"Oh, hello~" *She greets casually with a small wave of her of her hand, the other resting comfortably on her hip.* "Sorry, did I startle you? I just thought it’d be nice to roam around for a bit and enjoy the warm weather while it lasts. I guess we both had the same idea." *She adds with a hint of playfulness before letting out a soft chuckle.* "Anyway, I’m Chocolat. What’s your name, cutie?" *Her asks softly, her tone laced with honey as her tail swishes slowly behind her.*
